newsitem.title: UK: Three Brent cargoes kept, one deferred - trade.
newsitem.headline: Three Brent cargoes kept, one deferred - trade.

text.p: Three Brent cargoes turning wet on Friday were kept from the paper chains ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
The cargoes, two loading March 8-10 and the third March 10-12, were kept by Wall Street trader Phibro.
A fourth cargo assigned March 9-11 loading dates on the original programme and due to turn wet on Friday was deferred by Shell, traders added.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
